title: Items tuning
description: The shop's catalog and rules, owned by the Items domain (Item Bible v0.3; Economy & Progression Bible §10–§12; ADR-012 §3). VeyraItems binds it to FVeyraItemsTuning and checks the tier rules the schema cannot express. Prices and stats are prototype data (Item Bible §3).

stats.description: What an item adds to its holder while it is delivered and the holder lives (Item Bible §3). Flat amounts, except attackSpeed, a fraction of the Vanguard's base Attack Speed added to its level growth (ADR-012 §6).

attackSpeed.description: Bonus Attack Speed, as a fraction of base Attack Speed; 0.12 is 12%.

abilityHaste.description: Ability Haste: cooldowns last 100 / (100 + Ability Haste) of their base (ADR-012 §6).

critChance.description: Crit Chance, as a fraction; items' add (Combat Bible §5; ADR-023 §2).

magicPowerFraction.description: A percentage of total Magic Power, as a fraction, multiplying with every other (Combat Bible §41; ADR-023 §2).

stacking.description: A buff that stacks on each qualifying hit and refreshes its duration, up to a cap.

perStack.description: What each stack adds, in the stat's own unit.

maxStacks.description: The most stacks held at once.

durationSeconds.description: How long the stacks last after the latest qualifying hit.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

shop.description: The shop's own rules (Economy & Progression Bible §10, §12; ADR-012 §9).

inventorySlots.description: Normal inventory slots, shared by equipment, Boots, components and consumables (§10: six).

resaleFraction.description: What selling a used or carried-away item returns, as a fraction of the Gold spent on its present form (§12: 70%).

uniqueFromTier.description: Items of this tier and above may be held once each (ADR-012 §9).

maxBoots.description: The most Boots one Vanguard may hold (ADR-012 §9).

items.description: Every item the shop sells, by content ID (Item Bible §4–§10).

tier.description: 1 components, 2 assemblies, 3 Masterworks, 4 Mythicals (Item Bible §2, §11; ADR-025 §2).

category.description: Boots are limited per Vanguard; a consumable is used up; a Quest Item evolves by play (Item Bible §2.5; ADR-025 §3).

components.description: The items its recipe consumes, in any order; empty for a component and for an item a quest evolves into. Each is an item this file defines.

cost.description: A component's price, or a recipe's completion cost beyond its components (items never auto-combine, Item Bible §1). Above 0, except 0 for an item a quest evolves into, whose Gold is its base form's (ADR-025 §3).

stackLimit.description: How many share one slot; 1 for equipment.

active.description: The Active it grants, an ability Abilities.json defines; [] for none (Item Bible §2).

attunement.description: Its Attunements, which this file's Attunement maps define: exactly one on a Masterwork, two on a Mythical, none below (Item Bible §2, §11); a Quest Item's passive, at most one, sits here too (ADR-025 §3).

quests.description: Each Quest Item's quest, by its item's ID (Item Bible §2.5, §10; ADR-025 §3): what advances it, how far, and the Quest Item it becomes, which the shop never sells.

objective.description: What advances it: LaneFluxbornLastHits, the holder's credited last hits on enemy lane Fluxborn.

threshold.description: The progress at which it evolves.

evolvesInto.description: The Quest Item it becomes, at no cost.

consumables.description: What each consumable does when used, by its item's ID (Item Bible §12).

healthRestored.description: Health restored over the duration, in equal parts.

resaleFraction.description: What selling an unused one returns, as a fraction of its cost (Economy §12: a consumable defines its own).

charges.description: 0 for one that is used up; above 0, a refillable one: bought with this many charges, it spends one a use, refills at the fountain and from a secured Flux Well, and is held once (Item Bible §12; ADR-023 §6).

weightOfWar.description: Weight of War Attunements (Colossus Temper, Item Bible §8): Physical Power from bonus Health.

bonusHealthFraction.description: Physical Power gained per point of bonus Health (Max Health beyond base and level growth).

overcharge.description: Overcharge Attunements (Crown of the Crucible, Item Bible §9): a percentage of total Magic Power.

magicPowerFraction.description: Total Magic Power increase; 0.3 is 30%, a percentage bonus under Combat Bible §41.

spoolUp.description: Spool Up Attunements (Cycler Core, Item Bible §8): basic attacks against enemy Vanguards stack bonus Attack Speed.

overcycle.description: Overcycle Attunements (Arc Reactor, Item Bible §9): ability damage against enemy Vanguards stacks Ability Haste.

perfectCut.description: Perfect Cut: critical strikes deal increased damage (Item Bible §8; ADR-023 §3).

critDamageBonus.description: Added to the holder's Crit Damage, as a fraction of the attack's damage.

reprisalGuard.description: Reprisal Guard (Impact Aegis, Item Bible §8; ADR-023 §3): a basic attack or ability that damages an enemy Vanguard shields the holder for a fraction of what it dealt, then the Attunement waits.

damageFraction.description: The shield, as a fraction of what the triggering hit dealt after mitigation, shields included.

cooldownSeconds.description: How long the Attunement waits after it shields.

drag.description: Drag (Gravitic Seal, Item Bible §9; ADR-023 §3): ability damage to an enemy Vanguard slows it briefly.

slow.description: The fraction of Movement Speed removed.

convergence.description: Convergence (Starfall Prism, Item Bible §9; ADR-023 §3): ability damage to an enemy Vanguard primes it; the holder's next damaging ability on it within the window consumes the prime for bonus magic damage.

windowSeconds.description: How long a prime waits for the holder's next damaging ability.

baseDamage.description: The bonus magic damage before Magic Power.

magicPowerRatio.description: The bonus magic damage per point of the holder's Magic Power.

fracture.description: Fracture (Nullglass Lens, Item Bible §9; ADR-023 §3, §5): each instance of magic damage to an enemy Vanguard adds a stack of Magic Resist Reduction, perStack of its Magic Resistance each; the stacks refresh and end together.

endlessCleave.description: Endless Cleave (Razorwheel Prime, Item Bible §8; ADR-023 §3): each basic attack also deals a share of its base damage as Physical damage to the other enemies around its target, never structures.

meleeFraction.description: The share of the attack's base damage from a melee holder.

rangedFraction.description: The share from a ranged holder.

radius.description: Around the primary target, in units.

temperedByConflict.description: Tempered by Conflict (Siegeheart Core, Item Bible §8; ADR-023 §3): an enemy Vanguard that stays near the holder becomes Tempered; the holder's next basic attack on it consumes it for bonus Physical damage, part of which the holder keeps as Max Health while it holds the item. Each enemy has its own cooldown.

radius.description: How near the enemy must stay, body to body, in units.

chargeSeconds.description: How long it must stay near to become Tempered.

checkSeconds.description: How often the server looks for enemies near a holder.

baseDamage.description: The bonus Physical damage before Max Health.

maxHealthFraction.description: The bonus Physical damage per point of the holder's Max Health.

healthGainFraction.description: The share of the bonus damage kept as Max Health.

cooldownSeconds.description: Each enemy's own wait after it is consumed.

residualCurrent.description: Residual Current (Wayline Reservoir, Item Bible §10; ADR-025 §7): the holder's last hits on enemy lane Fluxborn store Current; once it has gone a while without enemy-Vanguard damage, it spends Current to amplify its Health Regeneration. That damage suspends the spending and keeps the Current.

quietSeconds.description: How long without enemy-Vanguard damage before Current is spent.

currentPerSecond.description: Current spent each second while it amplifies.

regenerationAmplification.description: What Health Regeneration is multiplied by while Current is spent; 3 triples it.

heldSeconds.description: How long a status it keeps on its holder lasts after each renewal; renewed every regeneration tick while it holds, it outlasts one.

dragTheTempo.description: Drag the Tempo (Riverhold Bastion, Item Bible §8; ADR-025 §7): an enemy Vanguard's basic attack that damages the holder slows the attacker's Attack Speed, refreshed and never stacked.

attackSpeedReduction.description: The fraction of the attacker's Attack Speed removed.

seconds.description: How long the slow lasts after the latest such attack.

quietingChime.description: Quieting Chime (Blackreef Bell, Item Bible §8; ADR-025 §7): the holder holds a Spell Shield (Combat Bible §19), which forms again once reformSeconds pass after both its consumption and the holder's last enemy-Vanguard damage.

reformSeconds.description: How long it takes to form again.

heldSeconds.description: How long a status it keeps on its holder lasts after each renewal; renewed every regeneration tick while it holds, it outlasts one.

markedForDoom.description: Marked for Doom (Doombringer Bow, Item Bible §8; ADR-025 §7): the holder's basic attacks on an enemy Vanguard build Doom on it; once Doomed, its next basic attack on it consumes the Doom for a share of its missing Health, as a Physical Proc.

doomPerCrit.description: Doom a crit adds in its place.

doomedAt.description: The Doom at which the target is Doomed.

expirySeconds.description: How long Doom lasts after it was last added.

missingHealthRatio.description: The Proc's Physical damage per point of the target's missing Health.

safeHarbor.description: Safe Harbor (Harborline Harness, Item Bible §8; ADR-025 §7): a share of the damage the holder's attacks and abilities deal enemy Vanguards banks as Reserve, up to a share of Max Health; out of Vanguard combat it converts into Health.

reserveFraction.description: The share of post-mitigation damage banked.

capMaxHealthFraction.description: The most Reserve, as a share of Max Health.

conversionMaxHealthFractionPerSecond.description: Reserve converted each second, as a share of Max Health.

highTide.description: High Tide (The Last Harbor, Item Bible §11; ADR-025 §7): last hits on enemy lane Fluxborn store Current; out of Vanguard combat it is spent to amplify Health Regeneration and speed Safe Harbor, and what they recover past full Health becomes Temporary Health (Combat Bible §7), up to a cap.

currentPerSecond.description: Current spent each second while it acts.

regenerationAmplification.description: What Health Regeneration is multiplied by while Current is spent; 3 triples it.

reserveConversionAcceleration.description: Added to Safe Harbor's conversion rate, as a share of it, while Current is spent; 1 doubles it.

overflowToTemporaryHealth.description: The share of recovery past full Health that becomes Temporary Health.

temporaryHealthCapMaxHealthFraction.description: The most Temporary Health it holds, as a share of Max Health.

temporaryHealthSeconds.description: How long its Temporary Health lasts after it was last added to.

heldSeconds.description: How long a status it keeps on its holder lasts after each renewal; renewed every regeneration tick while it holds, it outlasts one.
